items.review_rationale: Read the direct-system definition and the contravariantly induced inverse Hom systems, including eventual image stabilization at each index for every test module N; did not substitute a countable-only inverse sequence.

references.phrase: inverse system of R-modules indexed by a preorder

references.context: Precomposition with direct-system arrow M_i→M_j, reversing the direction of index maps

references.phrase: eventual image stabilization at every stage
references.disposition: This is precisely the Mittag-Leffler inverse-image condition, not stabilization of the M_i themselves.

items.review_rationale: Read the canonical tensor-versus-product comparison for arbitrary indexed families of test modules and ordinary injectivity of that comparison. The equivalent Stacks characterizations are not assumed to add unsupported prerequisites.

references.phrase: arbitrary direct product ∏_j Q_j of R-modules
references.context: Product R-module with coordinatewise operations for a possibly infinite index set j, distinct from direct sum
Natural R-linear map induced by coordinate projections of the product module

references.phrase: injectivity of the canonical tensor/product comparison
references.context: Ordinary injectivity of the comparison map for every test family; not universal injectivity of each constituent module homomorphism

references.phrase: equivalent conditions of the Stacks characterization
references.disposition: The formulation cites an equivalent criterion; no unlisted equivalence is silently treated as a new definition.

items.review_rationale: Examined cofinality of a subset within the actual well-order T, preserving the quantifiers and the non-strict comparison t≤a; neither a category-theoretic cofinal functor nor a merely dense subset.

references.phrase: for each t∈T some a∈A satisfies t≤a
references.disposition: This is the cofinal upper-bound predicate in the given well-order, not a claim of order density or categorical cofinality.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the ordinal cofinality definition via least ordinal order type of a cofinal subset and its alternative minimum-cardinality characterization; distinguished this from cofinality of a category and from ordinal successor.

references.phrase: cofinal subset of the well-ordered ordinal α

references.context: Bijective relation-preserving and order-reflecting map giving an ordinal the same order type as a cofinal subset

references.phrase: least order type and minimum-cardinality equivalence
references.disposition: These are two stated characterizations of cf(α) for a fixed ordinal, not unrelated notions or categorical functor cofinality.
